articles.title: Ukrainian strikes kill six in Russia, acting governor says
articles.description: A 14-year-old child was among four others injured, the acting governor of Russia's Belgorod region says.

articles.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
articles.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

articles.title: Trump downscales 'hostile' military drills with South Korea citing 'very good relationship' with Kim Jong Un
articles.description: Joint US military exercises with South Korea will be downscaled, Donald Trump says, as they are "hostile" and too expensive.
